sequence.description: Decimal string avoids JavaScript precision loss across a long-lived process.

ApiError.description: Deliberately contains no raw server messages, credentials or filesystem paths.

expected_length.description: None for unknown length, word/phrase codes, or malformed metadata.

next_delivery.description: None means Telegram does not offer another delivery method.

timeout_seconds.description: Remaining delay at the time TDLib produced this state; None if unknown.

reserved_bytes.description: Bytes not yet written but reserved by active downloads.

used_bytes.description: Completed files plus bytes already written by partial downloads.

CodeDelivery.description: Safe delivery metadata. Phone numbers, code hints, receipts and token URLs deliberately stay in TDLib and are not part of application diagnostics.

oneOf.description: Editor preflight rejected a fresh operation before any remote side effect.

LyricsReference.description: A small document in the vault, fetched independently of the audio bytes.

expected_order.description: Optimistic concurrency is enforced during server-ordered replay on every device.

ProjectionDiagnostics.description: Local, read-only accounting; no Telegram completeness is inferred from it.

uncovered_log_text_bytes.description: UTF-8 text bytes in the last fully audited post-barrier history.

unknown_protocol_records.description: None means the current history has not been completely verified.
